build.buildCommand: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'export PATH="/root/.nix-profile/bin:/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH"; if [ "${SERVICE_ROLE:-web}" = "worker" ]; then exec python worker.py; else exec gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py app:app; fi'
